name: Wisdio Companion

releases.author: Young-caveman
releases.description:
## What's new

- Sync images pasted into Wisdio notes to the attachment location configured in Obsidian.
- Track stable image identities across Obsidian renames and binary edits.
- Preserve Wisdio image copies when Obsidian references or files are removed.
- Recover missing attachments and detect conflicting image changes without silent overwrites.
- Require Obsidian 1.5.7 or newer.

## Install manually

Download `main.js` and `manifest.json`, then place them in `.obsidian/plugins/wisdio-companion/`. The ZIP contains the same two files.
releases.name: Wisdio Companion 1.2.0

releases.author: Young-caveman
releases.description:
Wisdio Companion connects the Wisdio browser extension to a local Obsidian vault, so you can take timestamped video notes without leaving the browser and keep them synchronized as Markdown.

## What is new in 1.0.6

- Adds revision-protected writes so stale browser content cannot silently overwrite newer Obsidian edits.
- Detects content and filename changes made in Obsidian and refreshes linked Wisdio notes.
- Tracks note identity with the managed `wisdio_id` YAML field, including after file renames and imports.
- Keeps the required `wisdio_id` placeholder in custom note templates.
- Improves Companion startup reliability and reports port conflicts clearly when multiple vaults use the same port.

## Install

1. Download `wisdio-companion-1.0.6.zip` and extract it.
2. Copy `main.js` and `manifest.json` into:

   `<your vault>/.obsidian/plugins/wisdio-companion/`

3. Enable **Wisdio Companion** in Obsidian.
4. Connect it from the Wisdio browser extension using the local endpoint and API key shown in the plugin settings.

Requires Obsidian 1.1.0 or newer on desktop.

[Wisdio website](https://wisdio.org) · [Documentation](https://wisdio.org/docs.html)
